name: no-mistakes
description: Deterministic impact maps, test plans, Playwright coverage, and repository checks for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Local AST graph: impact, tests, and checks.
interface.longDescription: Use no-mistakes from Codex to answer structural codebase questions from the resolved import graph: who uses a symbol or file, whether code is dead or only used by tests, which tests a change needs, whether a route has e2e coverage, and what to run before handing off a change.
defaultPrompt: Use no-mistakes to find every consumer of this symbol
Which tests does this change need?
Is this export only used by tests?
